com.esignal.jstandard.beans.history

Class DefaultHistoricalBar

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.history.DefaultHistoricalBar
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    HistoricalBar
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    IntradayHistoricalBar

    public class DefaultHistoricalBar
extends java.lang.Object
implements HistoricalBar
    DefaultHistoricalBar is a default implementation of the HistoricalBar interface. It does not implement Intraday specific bar length method.
    Since:
    01-001-0009
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
